main_body: A roofed stall: a blue-grey tiled roof canopy (rows 0-16) on two wooden posts, with a grey counter/basin below (rows 30-42) holding a blue water panel.
top_band: Roof: light grey-blue top band at rows ~1-3, then the slope with vertical tile columns down to row ~16. Counter top: light grey rim at rows 30-31 only. The central column reads as the roof slope.
evidence: The roof shows a lighter top cap and a sloped tile surface with a dark lower eave line at rows 15-17, and it reads like the reference stall roofs. A shadowed gap sits under the eave between the posts. The counter has a 2px light rim and a blue inset panel with a dark inner edge, so the counter top is thin, but the roof is the main body and has a clear top slope plus front. The roof reads as a 3/4 piece, comparable to the well roof reference.

style.evidence: The roof has about 5 steps of blue-grey with per-panel highlights and a tinted dark outline, comparable to the reference roofs. The posts are flat orange-brown with only a light edge and a dark side, and the counter is a large flat grey area (about 10x6 px) plus a flat blue panel. The transparent grey interior is empty. Overall it is thinner than the reference's textured wood and stone, with large flat fills on the counter and posts.
